text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Like I said, I just twisted my ankle a little.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"You really didn't need to go out of your way
to walk me all the way to the nurse's office."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now.
Come on, I need to get back to the rest of the routine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to take a leisurely break.
Because I have to run... I must.
choice_data_list: Not getting swept away by impatience is a strength in itself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to take a leisurely break.
Because I have to run... I must.
choice_data_list: Not getting swept away by impatience is a strength in itself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I won't let myself…… be swept away by impatience……
choice_data_list: Let's wait for your injury to heal for now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Understood.
For now, I shall rest and take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: For what it's worth, you are the Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reluctantly, Admire Vega
agreed to listen to the request.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...The pain is mild, too,
and moving around is—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Let's head back to the infirmary after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a dejected Admire Vega in tow,
I ended up having to head right back
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
It wasn't that bad of an injury to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You really don't have to watch me that closely.
I can't focus on practice."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Admire Vega continued her training to the extent that it wouldn't interfere with her injury.
